title: One analytics-goal key registry derived from the workspace's own stage axis

Case 7 tested per the critic (localizedSaveFailure over the real route response against all four catalogs, no component render). The 'Invalid value.' path (NaN / negative) also answers ANALYTICS_TARGET_OUT_OF_RANGE, so no uncoded 400 remains on the route.
notes: Commit order: codes+catalogs (lock) -> doc (lock) -> perf budget (lock) -> code; the code commit is the only non-shared one and each commit is green on its own for my paths. tsc exit 2 is foreign only (billing alerts tests from a sibling in flight at the time, ProfileTab.tsx, and the untracked kpi-sim/ tree); zero errors on my paths.
